newsitem.title: USA: Sibia drug may offer Parkinson's remedy.
newsitem.headline: Sibia drug may offer Parkinson's remedy.

text.p: Sibia Neurosciences Inc said Wednesday a study had shown its Sibia's SIB-1508Y pharmaceutical product demonstrates prolonged reversal of cognitive deficits in a primate model of the cognitive deficits in Parkinson's disease.

Scientists from Sibia and Allegheny University of the Health Sciences presented the findings at the American Society for Pharmacology and Experimental Therapeutics meeting in San Diego, the company said.
SIB-1508Y is one of SIBIA's proprietary neuronal nicotinic acetylcholine receptor agonists.

The company said that based on the data from these and other studies, it believes SIB-1508Y, now in Phase I clinical trials, could offer a new approach to the treatment of Parkinson's disease because of its ability to reduce both cognitive and motor deficits.
It is now recognized that cognitive impairment is a serious and frequent symptom in many Parkinson's patients, but no treatment addresses this aspect of the disease, Sibia said.
